evidence_based_reading: There are currently two directory places: WAITING ROOM (/enter; desktop-first; reached via ENTER 00) and LOCATIONS (/origin/locations; mobile-only; reached via SWIPE-UP and the bottom-nav centre bay). They list overlapping but different destinations. If MENU = WAITING ROOM, then LOCATIONS is the mobile composition of the same WAITING ROOM system.
proposal_for_review: One WAITING ROOM system with one destination registry and two viewport compositions (mobile = the canonical LOCATIONS authority, desktop/tablet = /enter). ENTER 00 and SWIPE-UP both open it; EXIT 00 leaves it. Replaces the prior Ground Zero proposal "LOCATIONS → MAP state of /enter".
